page.overview:
What is Circuits?

This is a list of Formula One circuits that have hosted a race in the Championship.

There have been 69 different circuits. The first was Silverstone in . The circuit that has hosted the most races is Monza, which as of has hosted 73 races (every season bar ). The newest is the Las Vegas Strip Circuit, which hosted the inaugural Las Vegas Grand Prix, in .

Circuits in bold are scheduled to be used in the season, while circuits in italics were planned to host a race, but never did.
